no_permission: §cYou do not have permission to use MineBackup.
argument_parse_failed: §cCould not parse the arguments. Put names containing spaces in double quotes.
invalid_backup_file: §cThe backup file must be one safe file name and cannot contain a path.
invalid_config_id: §cConfig IDs may contain only letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.
invalid_text: §cThe argument cannot be empty or contain control characters and must not exceed %s characters.
invalid_minutes_number: §cThe automatic-backup interval must be a whole number of minutes.
invalid_minutes_range: §cThe automatic-backup interval must be between 1 and %s minutes.
busy: §eMineBackup is already running another save-changing operation. Try again later.
help_save: §b/mb save §7- Save all players and loaded worlds now
help_backup: §b/mb backup [comment] §7- Hot-back up the current world
help_restore: §b/mb restore [backup-file] §7- Safely restore the current world; omit the file for latest
help_restore_control: §b/mb confirm | stop §7- Run now or cancel a restore countdown
help_list: §b/mb list configs|folders|backups §7- Query FolderRewind backup catalogs
help_target_backup: §b/mb target backup <config-id> <folder> [comment] §7- Back up a selected target
help_auto: §b/mb auto start <minutes> | auto stop §7- Manage current-world automatic hot backups
help_status: §b/mb status | reload §7- Inspect runtime status or reload configuration
save_started: §7Synchronously saving all players and loaded worlds to disk...
save_success: §aPlayer data and %s loaded world(s) were saved safely.
save_failed: §cFailed to save player or world data: §f%s
backup_submitted: §7Backup request submitted; waiting for FolderRewind. Request ID: §f%s
auto_backup_submitted: §7[MineBackup] Automatic hot-backup request submitted; waiting for FolderRewind.
backup_preparing: §7[MineBackup] Saving the world and pausing autosave for a consistent hot backup...
backup_no_changes: §7[MineBackup] No file changes were detected, so no new backup was created.
autosave_resumed: §7[MineBackup] Backup flow finished; each world's original autosave state was restored.
restore_cancelled: §e[MineBackup] The pending restore was cancelled; the world will not be changed.
no_pending_restore: §eThere is no restore countdown to control; the restore may already be submitted.
restore_submitted: §6[MineBackup] Restore submitted and can no longer be cancelled; waiting for FolderRewind.
restore_preparing: §6[MineBackup] FolderRewind is ready to restore; saving data and preparing a safe handoff.
restore_handoff: §6[MineBackup] Restore ownership was handed to the Sidecar. The server is stopping safely and the configured script will start it again afterward.
restore_kick:
§6[MineBackup]
§eThe server is restoring a backup and will restart.
